build_GemmaKVCachingTransformer_from_unc: build a GemmaKVCachingTransformer from an uncached GemmaTransformer with a specified cache length and batch axes
create_GemmaKVCachingAttention_from_unca: create a GemmaKVCachingAttention layer from an uncached GemmaAttention with cache length and cached axes
create_GemmaKVCachingInputs_from_basic_s: create GemmaKVCachingInputs from basic token subsegments with automatic position array and causal mask generation
run_GemmaKVCachingTransformer_call: run the GemmaKVCachingTransformer with token inputs to produce logits and updated key-value cache state
build_GemmaKVCachingState: build a GemmaKVCachingState holding key-value caches, cache length, batch axes, and current cache end index
